scenarios.name: upstream baseline
scenarios.detail: two independent servers cannot own the same trait directory

scenarios.name: HTTP authentication
scenarios.detail: missing or incorrect bearer credentials are rejected before MCP initialization

scenarios.name: shared HTTP sessions
scenarios.detail: three independent MCP clients connect to one unchanged trait collection

scenarios.name: concurrent source selection
scenarios.detail: main checkout, worktree and separate repo return their own unsaved content and SHA-256 snapshot

scenarios.name: new worktree
scenarios.detail: a worktree created after server startup works with no Traits files or configuration

scenarios.name: Git filtering
scenarios.detail: ignored files rejected; tracked-but-ignored and new untracked source files remain eligible

scenarios.name: file boundaries
scenarios.detail: outside paths, escaping symlinks, .env, relative paths and literal filenames with glob syntax are rejected

scenarios.name: shared approval and persistence
scenarios.detail: unapproved fixture trait is absent; approved save is immediately visible to another client

scenarios.name: competing proposals
scenarios.detail: one client's different proposal cannot turn another client's approval into an unintended save

scenarios.name: checkout footprint
scenarios.detail: no traits.ts, .agents directory, dependencies or setup files in any fixture checkout
